players.bio: Albert Robert Morgan (born 2 February 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Blackpool . Born in Portsmouth, Morgan joined Charlton Athletic at a young age and signed his first professional contract in May 2018.

Andrew Lyons (born 2 August 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Blackpool. Club career Youth career A native of Naas, County Kildare, Lyons originally played with Dublin club St Joseph's Boys until July 2016 when he signed for League of Ireland club Bray Wanderers under-17 side, although a month later he signed for the under-17 side of Bohemians in August 2016.

Bailey Peacock-Farrell (born 29 October 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Blackpool. Born in England, he plays for the Northern Ireland national team. Born and raised in England, he plays international football for Northern Ireland. Born and raised in England, he plays international football for Northern Ireland.

Christopher Nathan Hamilton (commonly known as CJ Hamilton; born 23 March 1995) is an English footballer who plays for Blackpool. Hamilton began his career with Sheffield United and spent time out on loan at Halifax Town and Gateshead in the 2015–16 season. He joined Mansfield Town in June 2016 and made his professional debut on 9 August 2016 against Blackburn Rovers in the EFL Cup.
Dale Taylor (born 12 December 2003) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Blackpool and the Northern Ireland national team.
Dion Elie Raymond Charles is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Blackpool on loan from EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.

Finley Christopher Ryan Munroe (born 8 February 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Blackpool, on loan from EFL Championship club Middlesbrough.
Fraser Matthew Horsfall (born 12 November 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays for Blackpool, as a defender.

George Christopher Honeyman (born 8 September 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Blackpool. A product of Sunderland's youth academy, Honeyman made his professional debut in February 2015. He had a brief spell on loan with Gateshead during the 2015–16 season before returning and assuming the captaincy in 2018. He joined Hull City a year later.
Hayden Ross Coulson (born 17 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One side Blackpool.

Ian Ross Evatt (born 19 November 1981) is an English professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of Blackpool. Evatt began his career as a central midfielder, but was later converted to a centre-back.
Ilmari Niskanen is a Finnish professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder, left winger, or wing-back for Blackpool F.C. in EFL League One and the Finland national team.
Jerry Aaron Yates (born 10 November 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Blackpool, on loan from EFL League One club Luton Town.

Jordan Brian Brown (born 21 June 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Blackpool. Brown made his debut for Derby County as a substitute in a 2–0 away defeat to West Bromwich Albion on 8 July 2020. On 24 January 2022, Brown signed an 18-month contract with EFL League Two side Leyton Orient.

Jordan Lee Williams (born 22 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for EFL League One club Blackpool, on loan from EFL Championship club Portsmouth. A product of the Huddersfield Town Academy, he was loaned out to Bury in August 2017, just 2 days after making his debut in the League Cup against Rotherham United.

Joshua Luke Bowler is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL League One club Blackpool. He has previously played for Blackpool, Queens Park Rangers, Everton, and Hull City.
Joshua John Francis Earl is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Blackpool fc
Karoy Zidane Lovebourne Anderson (born 1 October 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Blackpool.
Leighton Owen Clarkson is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Blackpool.

Luke Kevin Southwood (born 6 December 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Blackpool. Born in England, he plays for the Northern Ireland national team. Club On 11 May 2018, Reading announced that they had offered a new contract to Luke Southwood, with a new two-year contract being confirmed as signed on 2 July 2018.

Michael Uzoukwu Absalom Jude Ihiekwe (born 20 November 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Blackpool. Ihiekwe was a member of his local side, Liverpool's academy system, before he was released during the 2010–11 season. He soon joined the youth ranks of Wolverhampton Wanderers, with whom he signed a professional contract in 2011.
Niall Nathan Michael Ennis (born 20 May 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Blackpool.
Oliver Joseph Casey (born 14 October 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Blackpool. He has previously played for Leeds United.

Thomas Stanley Bloxham (born 1 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for club Blackpool. Bloxham was born in Leicester, England. Growing up, he attended Leysland High School and Oswestry School. He played football for the school whilst attending.

Zachary Ashworth (born 6 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Blackpool. Born in England, he represents Wales internationally. Club career West Bromwich Albion Ashworth joined West Bromwich Albion's academy aged 10. He signed a two-year professional contract with the club in July 2021.
